title: A Synthetic Multivariate Refrigerator Time-Series Dataset for Predictive Maintenance
abstract: arXiv:2609.22229v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We generated synthetic multivariate time series for 27 refrigerators with a simplified physicsinspired simulator at one-minute resolution. The simulator includes ambient-temperature variation, door use, thermostat and compressor operation, heat exchange, defrost, electrical consumption, and six progressive degradation types. Each refrigerator provides 15 to 20 sensor outputs according to its configuration. The dataset contains 7,066,161 rows in 27 time-series files and 27 failure logs. The release also includes the Python generator, refrigerator configurations, and documentation. The data can support failure prediction, degradation analysis, and learning across refrigerators with different sensor-output sets.

translated_title: 用于预测性维护的合成多变量冰箱时间序列数据集
translated_abstract: 我们使用一个简化的物理启发式模拟器，以一分钟的分辨率生成了27台冰箱的合成多变量时间序列。该模拟器包含环境温度变化、门的使用、恒温器和压缩机运行、热交换、除霜、电力消耗以及六种渐进式退化类型。每台冰箱根据其配置提供15到20个传感器输出。该数据集包含27个时间序列文件中的7,066,161行数据以及27个故障日志。本次发布还包括Python生成器、冰箱配置和文档。这些数据可以支持故障预测、退化分析，以及跨不同传感器输出集合的冰箱之间的学习。
tldr: 该论文发布了一个由物理启发式模拟器生成的、包含27台冰箱共700多万行数据的合成多变量时间序列数据集，可用于支持冰箱的故障预测、退化分析和预测性维护研究。
en_tdlr: This paper releases a synthetic multivariate time-series dataset of 27 refrigerators with over 7 million rows, generated by a physics-inspired simulator, to support failure prediction, degradation analysis, and predictive maintenance research.
